visual_connections.description: S3 upload triggers the Step Functions workflow.
Step Functions kicks off the transcode job in MediaConvert.
Step Functions triggers Rekognition for video analysis.
Step Functions triggers Transcribe for audio-to-text translation.
MediaConvert outputs generated proxy metadata to DynamoDB.
Rekognition stores extracted visual metadata in DynamoDB.
Transcribe sends translated text to Comprehend for analysis.
Comprehend stores text analysis results in DynamoDB.
DynamoDB data is ingested into the Reach Engine platform (represented by EC2/EKS).
